sql: SELECT id,TRANSFORM(numbers,x -> TRANSFORM(numbers,x -> x+k)) AS result FROM (SELECT numbers,k,id FROM interaction_lambda_mixed) q

SELECT l.id,TRANSFORM(l.numbers,x -> x+l.k) AS result FROM interaction_lambda_mixed l JOIN interaction_lambda_mixed r ON l.id=r.id AND EXISTS(l.numbers,x -> x+l.k>r.k)

SELECT id,CASE WHEN EXISTS(numbers,x -> x+k>0) THEN TRANSFORM(numbers,x -> x+k) ELSE TRANSFORM(numbers,x -> x-k) END AS result FROM interaction_lambda_mixed q
